crossRefs.note: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.
Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the…
I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down, that we may walk over…
On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet, They cast up against me their ways of destruction.

translations.web: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.
translations.bsb: His troops advance together; they construct a ramp against me and encamp around my tent.
translations.kjv: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
translations.asv: His troops come on together, And cast up their way against me, And encamp round about my tent.
